newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Three Russian banks in Eurobond syndicate.
newsitem.headline: Three Russian banks in Eurobond syndicate.

text.p: First Deputy Finance Minister Andrei Vavilov said on Friday that syndicate for the $1 billion Russian Eurobond launched on Thursday included three Russian banks.
He told reporters that International Company for Finance and Investment, (IFCI, or MFK in Russian), Alfa-Bank and Unikombank were part of the primary syndicate.
JP Morgan and SBC Warburg co-lead-managed the issue.
Natsionalny Rezervny Bank had previously said it was in the syndicate, but chairman Alexander Lebedev confirmed on Friday that it had been dropped.
